latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – generate professional attendance sheets in xlsx format from employee work information.

- Input employee names, date range, and attendance types; supports both text and JSON formats.
- Produces Excel files with employee names, date columns, attendance statuses (with color coding), and summary statistics.
- Suitable for HR, team management, and daily or monthly attendance tracking.
- Includes usage examples and professional formatting for reports.
